title: New Plymouth School District
description:
https://www.npschools.us/
									New Plymouth School District (District 372) is a small public school district in Payette County, Idaho. It serves approximately 1000 students in three schools. Due to a security breach, educational records (grades, attendance, disciplinary records), personal information (names, addresses, Social Security numbers) of students and staff, and medical/health records were compromised and are being disclosed.
